BehaviorTree._description: Promotes a reviewed shelf-board candidate to the shared wall_board section used to place the shelving. Apply only when the board has the existing physical location and marked origin assumed by board_offsets.yaml. This also changes the scene pose inherited by the EPick config.

Action.message: Applied wall_board. Its pose now drives shelf placement in the 2F-85 and inherited EPick scene. Restart and verify the shelves before planning.

SubTree.input_port: Reviewed cell_calibration.yaml section containing the fixed shelf board pose in world.
